answer: Mechanism: aged stake escrow. Each new identity posts a small refundable bond that must mature through an aging window before its grades carry weight. Honest agents lose nothing; bonds return after clean service. An attacker forging N identities pays N bonds up front, waits N aging delays, and forfeits every bond when the jury cross-checks correlated voting and marks the fake cohort sable. Like one mesa rising from a sand plain, a single aged identity stands apart from a storm of fresh fakes, slashed at dawn of the next epoch. Forgery is priced; honesty is free.
